personajes.en: Suntanned mestizo man, short black hair, light mustache, wearing a faded red polo shirt, jeans and worn sneakers with a plain helmet tucked under one arm, holding a small phone mount for his motorcycle.

Afro-Colombian woman with braided hair tied in a bun, wearing a floral blouse, dark leggings and flat sandals, a fanny pack across her chest and a folding stand with stacked folded clothing over one forearm.
Weathered mestizo highland farmer, gray stubble, dark straw hat, gray poncho-style wool ruana over a checkered shirt, rubber boots, holding a small plastic basket of ripe red coffee cherries.

Mestizo man with sun-dark skin, buzz cut, dusty yellow hard hat, sleeveless gray undershirt, khaki work pants and scuffed leather boots, mortar-stained hands holding a masonry trowel and string level.
Slim mestizo young man, curly dark hair, wearing a plain navy hoodie, jeans and canvas sneakers, a worn gray backpack over both shoulders and a student ID card lanyard around his neck.
Small-framed mestiza grandmother, silver hair in a low bun, round glasses, pale lavender cardigan over a pleated skirt, comfortable white walking shoes, carrying a canvas market bag with vegetables.
Slim Afro-Colombian young man, short fade haircut, thin beard, black apron over a plain white shirt, dark jeans and black sneakers, holding electric hair clippers and a small neck brush.

personajes.oficio: Vendedora de dulces en la frontera
personajes.en: Venezuelan-born mestiza woman with shoulder-length brown hair, plain gray sweatshirt, black leggings and old athletic shoes, a padded baby carrier on her chest and a tray of small wrapped candies at her side.
